title: Soar
description: Receives [gold]50%[/gold] less attack damage until it lands.
smart_description: Receives [blue]50%[/blue] less attack damage until it lands.
notes: Soar is a single-instance buff that reduces all attack damage received by the power's owner by 50%. The effect persists until the enemy lands an attack (presumably the monster lands from flying/hovering). Damage reduction is applied via ModifyDamageMultiplicative with a multiplier of 0.5 for all powered attacks targeting the owner.
